shortDescription: Configure Kerberos keytab entries in Fortinet's FortiOS and FortiGate.

options.name: access_token
options.description: Token-based authentication. Generated from GUI of Fortigate.

options.name: member_path
options.description: Member attribute path to operate on. Delimited by a slash character if there are more than one attribute. Parameter marked with member_path is legitimate for doing member operation.

options.name: member_state
options.description: Add or delete a member under specified attribute path. When member_state is specified, the state option is ignored.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates whether to create or remove the object.

options.name: vdom
options.description: Virtual domain, among those defined previously. A vdom is a virtual instance of the FortiGate that can be configured and used as a different unit.
